title: fix(plugin-detail): a detail section on a print page prints every declared field and no "Show N empty fields" button
body:
Fixes #12717
Clause-②: no

## What

On a page that declares `print`, a `record:details` section prints every field it declares. The "Show N empty fields" / "Hide empty fields" button no longer reaches paper.

`packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` hides empty fields for two reasons, and they belong to two different owners.

- `shouldAutoHideEmpty` is the renderer's own density heuristic. No author declares it, and it depends on the viewport (`useIsMobile`) and on a ratio of empty fields, so it is a screen concern. On a print page it is now off. Every declared field prints, an empty one as the shared placeholder dash. The toggle is derived from the heuristic (`showEmptyToggle = emptyCount > 0 && shouldAutoHideEmpty`), so with no auto-hide there is no toggle. This follows card ②'s rule (objectui#11958): `record:details` is in the printable block subset because it prints every field it declares. That is the same reason the collapsed section already opens on paper.
- `hideAllEmptySection` (`section.hideEmpty === true`) is the authored `record:details` key. On paper it keeps doing what it declares: an all-empty section prints nothing at all, with no heading and no control. It is not gated.

`usePrintPage()` is now read once, above every early return (`isPrintPage`). The existing collapse gate and the new heuristic gate both read that one value.

Not done, deliberately:
- No `print:hidden` on the button. The empty fields would still be missing from the paper.
- No change to `page-print.ts`.
- The gate stays local to the heuristic, so objectui#12618 (the on-screen all-empty fold, on hold) can change that fold and keep this gate.

Off a print page, the toggle, the heuristic and the authored hide are unchanged.

## Tests

`packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/detailSectionPrintEmptyToggle-12717.test.tsx`, all at head 9f28cd2:
1. Inside a `PrintPageProvider`: no toggle, all four declared fields present, two placeholders.
2. Inside a `PrintPageProvider`: an authored `hideEmpty: true` all-empty section renders nothing.
3. Control, off a print page: the toggle reads "Show 2 empty fields" and the empty rows are hidden.

Each test was proven red by a one-off ablation, then restored. Each restore was checked: blob 576f471d0f52 equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Deleting the print gate turns test 1 red.
- Gating the authored hide on print (the wrong fix) turns test 2 red.
- Turning the heuristic off everywhere turns test 3 red.

`pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail` at 9f28cd2: 275 files passed, 1 skipped; 2663 tests passed, 14 skipped.

## Local gates (9f28cd2)

All of these exited 0:
- the closure build for `@object-ui/plugin-detail`;
- the `@object-ui/plugin-detail` build and type-check;
- the console build with `VITE_BASE_PATH=/console/`;
- `check:changeset-claims`, `changeset:check`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:spec-symbols` and the changeset presence check.

eslint on the changed files reports 0 errors. Its 12 warnings were all in `DetailSection.tsx` already; the base file has the same 12.

## Acceptance notes

- NOT MEASURED: PDF reading. The showcase invoice print page `showcase_invoice_document` is not in the published showcase at `@objectstack/cli@18.0.0-next.2`, nor in objectstack `main` 6d1660d. As a fallback, I added a throwaway page-level `print` to a showcase record page in a scratch copy of the backend. It never reached the served page metadata, and no print page mounted on the record route, so no before/after PDF could be rendered.
- Other controls in this file on paper:
  - A collapsible section's disclosure chevron still prints, inside the header button that card ② opens. It is outside this claim's file surface, so it is reported, not fixed.
  - The hover copy and pencil buttons are invisible until hover, so they draw nothing on paper.
